scripts.validator:start: cd ../program && cargo build-sbf --features devnet && cd - && solana-test-validator --ledger "$HOME/test-ledger" --bpf-program 4h3XoNReAgEcHVxcZ8sw2aufi9MTr7BbvYYjzjWDyDxS ../target/deploy/lazorkit_program.so --reset --quiet &
